target_customer: Workplaces and communities that want to engage their members
problem: Organizations lack a no-code tool to run and measure member engagement beyond surveys.

founders.name: Bhavesh Khandelwal
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. Search snippets (Crunchbase, The Org) say CTO and a later role at Dezerv, not opened.

founders.name: Rahul Khanna
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. No bio found.

technical_complexity.rationale: A no-code survey and engagement tool is standard web engineering. Product detail beyond the YC description was not found.

defensibility.rationale: Survey and engagement tools are widely available and no data or integration lock-in is described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes any incumbent response. The company compared itself to SurveyMonkey in its YC description.

market_need_then: The YC description argues that workplaces and communities need an Engagement Management System, with no dated evidence of spend or complaints found.

branding.domain_note: thunderpod.com is the listed website; the page now shows a Launching Soon placeholder with a 2025 copyright.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material was found. YourStory profiles a different company also named Thunderpod, which shows the name is confusable.

outcome_analysis: Thunderpod joined YC Winter 2020 from Bengaluru with a no-code engagement management pitch and is marked inactive by YC. No funding, press, shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty. The website now shows only a launching soon placeholder.
notes: No funding found in two searches; unknown is not zero. Competitor search found only an undated directory listing (serchen) naming Clarity Wave and Beekeeper, so the list is empty. A different Thunderpod (health and fitness creators, YourStory) exists and was excluded. A directory also describes a 360 wellness platform, possibly a later product, unverified.
